coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: P23

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- real landscaped/paved open land per Esri satellite imagery and the street/already-tracked-polygon-bounded gap computation, divided at owner-specified cross-sectional seams rather than a surveyed parcel boundary. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found in this pass. The remaining ~5,785 sqm of the original fragment (the building-hugging plaza strip, the panhandle, and P24's own dropped horns) is deliberately left untracked as its own P-number pending further review.
notes.digitized_from: Real-gap-fragment technique: bbox.difference(street buffer).difference(already-tracked polygons) around the UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision / 499 Illinois St / Chase Center area (fragment 2, 19,181.78 sqm raw). The owner reviewed a 3-way width-scan split of that fragment (at its two real cross-sectional waists, lat 37.7658 and 37.76665) and then gave a precise construction: P23 is the north piece (piece2, the lawn wedge by the Chase Center roundabout) with its thin building-hugging 'panhandle' dropped, plus the part of the middle piece (piece1, the plaza) that lies east of the seam where piece2's lawn narrows into that panhandle, extended south.

record.notes: OCII plan open-space parcel P23. Landscaped lawn and plaza between the Chase Center roundabout and the pavilion, east of the UCSF Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision.
